5. **Panel Discussion Moderator Request**: Laura Beck, Lead Organizer of the Egyptology Summit, invites Prof. Smith to moderate a panel discussion on 'Technological Innovations in Archaeology' scheduled for June 20th, citing his expertise and reputation in the field.
